methodology: MEASURED metrics over loopback TLS 1.3, in-process (LOCAL evidence, spec §2/§30 — NOT physical cross-device). Wire bytes from transport counters; wall-clock from std::time::Instant; CPU + peak RSS from getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF). endpoint_changed_symbols is a SEPARATE symbol-distance metric (spec §5.6), never bytes and never runtime. Each config runs REPS times; rep 0 is discarded as warmup.
